POWER MECHANICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #6
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: POWER MECHANICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. CPU
   B. Monitor
   C. Keyboard
   D. Speaker

2. When learning Motor Vehicle Chassis, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Motor Vehicle Chassis.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Motor Vehicle Chassis.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Motor Vehicle Chassis.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Motor Vehicle Chassis.

3. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Overload every socket
   B. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   C. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   D. Ignore burnt cables

4. When learning General workshop rules and regulations, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for General workshop rules and regulations.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for General workshop rules and regulations.
   C. Skip safety briefings for General workshop rules and regulations.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after General workshop rules and regulations.

5. When learning Overview of Power Mechanics as a learning area, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Overview of Power Mechanics as a learning area.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Overview of Power Mechanics as a learning area.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Overview of Power Mechanics as a learning area.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Overview of Power Mechanics as a learning area.

6. When learning Power Mechanics workshop layout, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Power Mechanics workshop layout.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Power Mechanics workshop layout.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Power Mechanics workshop layout.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Power Mechanics workshop layout.

7. When learning General workshop rules and regulations 2.0 Related Technical Drawing 2 1. Diagon, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for General workshop rules and regulations 2.0 Related Technical Drawing 2 1. Diagon.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for General workshop rules and regulations 2.0 Related Technical Drawing 2 1. Diagon.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for General workshop rules and regulations 2.0 Related Technical Drawing 2 1. Diagon.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after General workshop rules and regulations 2.0 Related Technical Drawing 2 1. Diagon.

8. When learning Blending of lines and curves, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Blending of lines and curves.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Blending of lines and curves.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Blending of lines and curves.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Blending of lines and curves.

9. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Input Cable Tester
   B. Internal Cooking Timer
   C. International Cricket Team
   D. Information and Communication Technology

10. When learning Road wheels, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Road wheels.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Road wheels.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Road wheels.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Road wheels.

11. When learning Road wheels 3.2 Motor Vehicle body 3.3 Motor Vehicle chassis 3.4 Motor Vehicle b, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Road wheels 3.2 Motor Vehicle body 3.3 Motor Vehicle chassis 3.4 Motor Vehicle b.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Road wheels 3.2 Motor Vehicle body 3.3 Motor Vehicle chassis 3.4 Motor Vehicle b.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Road wheels 3.2 Motor Vehicle body 3.3 Motor Vehicle chassis 3.4 Motor Vehicle b.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Road wheels 3.2 Motor Vehicle body 3.3 Motor Vehicle chassis 3.4 Motor Vehicle b.

12. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Remove all guards
   B. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   C. Run with the tool
   D. Work alone with eyes closed

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Engines and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Classifications of Engines and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Classifications of Engine 4.4 Engine Components Page 14 of 58 1 STRAND 1.0: FUND and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Types of Engines and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

====

4. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for General workshop rules and regulations.

7. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for General workshop rules and regulations 2.0 Related Technical Drawing 2 1. Diagon.

8. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Blending of lines and curves.

9. D — Information and Communication Technology

10. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Road wheels.
